title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=x^2$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{4-2}{4}=0.5$$. The endpoints of the subintervals are $$2$$, $$2.5$$, $$3$$, $$3.5$$ and $$4$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$T_4=0.25\left(f{\left(2\right)}+2f{\left(2.5\right)}+2f{\left(3\right)}+2f{\left(3.5\right)}+f{\left(4\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$18.75$$.
